title: Case-(vi) relative-trace APN equivalence to Gold functions
summary: Determine whether every case-(vi) relative-trace APN function is CCZ-equivalent to a Gold APN function.

formal_statement.body: For every source-admissible APN function $f$ in case (vi) of Theorem 2, prove that there exists a Gold APN power function $G(x)=x^{2^j+1}$ with $f\sim_{\mathrm{CCZ}}G$, or exhibit an admissible $f$ outside all Gold CCZ classes.

scope.domain: CCZ-equivalence classes of the source's relative-trace quadratic APN functions
assumptions: $f_{i,s,a,b,c}(x)=a\operatorname{Tr}_m^n(bx^{2^i+1})+a^q\operatorname{Tr}_m^n(cx^{2^s+1})$ is an APN instance in the indicated case of source Theorem 2
scope.unresolved_remainder: The claimed containment of the complete case-(vi) family in the Gold CCZ classes remains unproved in the inspected literature.

progress.summary: The case-(vi) branch of assertion 5 conjectures CCZ equivalence to Gold APN functions.
